questions.question: Before sharing a dramatic online claim, what is the best first step?
choices: Check the original source and seek independent corroboration
Share it quickly so others can decide
Trust it if many accounts repeat it
Judge its truth by the number of emojis

questions.question: A post asks users to enter a password through an unfamiliar link. What is the safest response?
choices: Reuse the password to test the link
Do not enter credentials; verify the request through the official service
Forward the link to friends
Enter a fake password and personal details

questions.question: What does a strong password practice include?
choices: Using the same short password on every site
Including a public birthday
Using unique, hard-to-guess passwords and a password manager when available
Sharing it with a group chat

questions.question: A student wants to use an online image in a project. What should they check?
choices: Whether it appears in the first search result
Whether the file name is short
Whether the image has no visible watermark
Its license or permission and the required attribution

questions.question: A website headline says a study 'proves' a food causes a health outcome, but the linked study reports only an association. What should a reader conclude?
choices: The headline overstates what the study establishes
Association always proves causation
The study must be fake
The food has no possible effect

questions.question: What is a digital footprint?
choices: A device's screen size
The trail of information created by a person's online activity
A private browsing window
A computer's physical location only

questions.question: A classmate posts an embarrassing photo of someone without consent. What is a responsible response?
choices: Download it for later
Add a mocking comment
Avoid resharing it and use appropriate reporting or support channels
Post it to another platform

questions.question: A message claims to come from a school but uses a misspelled domain and urgent payment demand. What should the recipient do?
choices: Pay immediately to avoid a threat
Reply with financial information
Assume the logo proves it is authentic
Verify through a known official contact before acting

questions.question: What does two-factor authentication add?
choices: A second verification step beyond the password
A second public profile
A guarantee that no account can be hacked
A way to share passwords safely

questions.question: A student uses an AI-generated summary for research. Which practice is strongest?
choices: Cite the summary as primary evidence
Verify key claims against credible sources and follow class disclosure rules
Assume it is accurate because it is fluent
Submit it without reading it

questions.question: Which action respects copyright when using a creator's work?
choices: Remove the creator's name
Assume anything online is public domain
Follow the license terms and credit the creator as required
Change the file name and claim ownership

questions.question: A private group chat begins sharing a rumor about a student. What action best limits harm?
choices: Post the rumor publicly
Ask others to add details
Save it to embarrass the student later
Do not forward it; report threats or harassment to a trusted adult or platform

questions.question: Why might a free app request access to contacts and location?
choices: It may collect data beyond what its core function needs
Every permission is automatically necessary
Permissions have no privacy effect
The app cannot operate without every permission

questions.question: Which choice best protects personal information on a public profile?
choices: Post a home address for verification
Limit identifying details and review privacy settings
Share travel plans in real time with everyone
Use a public profile for account recovery answers

questions.question: A student sees an edited image presented as a news photograph. What should they check?
choices: Only whether the image looks realistic
The number of shares
The original context, source, date, and independent reporting
The font used in the caption

questions.question: A website's article is sponsored by a company whose product it praises. What should readers consider?
choices: Sponsorship proves the product is safe
The article cannot contain any facts
The article is independent by definition
The sponsor may have an interest that shapes the article

questions.question: Which online comment contributes most constructively to a disagreement?
choices: A response that addresses the claim with evidence and respectful language
A personal insult
A threat to expose private information
A repeated rumor

questions.question: What is phishing?
choices: A method of compressing files
A deceptive attempt to obtain sensitive information by impersonation
A secure way to store passwords
A type of licensed image

questions.question: Why should people consider an audience before posting?
choices: A post disappears once viewed
Only intended readers can access it
Posts can be copied, shared, and interpreted outside their original context
Audience has no effect on meaning

questions.question: A friend sends a link to a shocking video but cannot identify its source. What is the most responsible choice?
choices: Share it with a warning but no verification
Assume it is current
Use its caption as proof
Pause sharing and verify the video and context first
